messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['During our regularly scheduled account maintenance and verification procedures, we have detected a slight error in your billing information.', 'Status: WAITING CONFIRMATION', 'This email confirms that you have added the following address to your account: Flat 29 468 Scrapbook Road South Yorkshire, S13 7\xa0GB United Kingdom', 'All occupants of the vehicle unfortunately lost their lives.', 'We would like to notify you that Lloyds Bank carries out8SN customer details verification procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'Your access to Online Services has been suspended.', 'Thanks for your order, gradwell@highwayman.com', 'Your access to online banking has been suspended temporary for security reasons by HSBC, N. A', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'We have encountered difficulty verifying your account information.', 'GMAC Bank has recently changed its name to be Ally bank, and these days we introduce a new version of banking software.', 'You have 4 unread message(s)...', 'HSBC Account Holder, Access suspended.', 'For your protection, please for...', 'Our Banks Automated IP security section has noticed unusual activity on your account.', 'Your online banking password was entered incorrectly more than 3 times.', 'Your email (howiem@bigfoot.com) is almost full.', 'YOUR WINNING PRIZE OF TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTYTHOUSAND GREAT BRITISH POUNDS (GBP-250,000.00) HAS BEEN DEPOSITED IN\xa0A BANK HERE FOR SECURITY REASONS', 'Your contact information has been updated', 'For your protection Internet Banking access to your account(s) has been blocked.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
